episode_summary: This episode introduces the 'Empty Stage Method,' encouraging real estate agents to leverage TikTok for lead generation. With low competition and a large audience, TikTok offers a unique opportunity for agents to stand out by posting consistent, local content. Overcoming common barriers and misconceptions about the platform can position agents as trusted local experts.
